crime: Every evening her roommate sat under the courtyard tree until lockup call, watching the fireworks {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic sent up from her fingertips at nine o'clock.
One night before nine, the roommate took {WITCH_NAME}'s hand and folded her fingers into her palm. "Not tonight. Sit in the quiet with me. You don't have to keep lighting them for me."
Long ago, after the last firework of a festival, her mother had lifted her down from her shoulders, said "Wait here," and never come back. Ever since, when it went quiet, someone was leaving.

In the quiet after her roommate closed that hand, {WITCH_NAME} pressed both hands over the girl's mouth and nose until she was still. She sat her against the trunk, face up, and opened her eyes to the sky.

At nine she sent her show bursting over the courtyard. With every flash, the prisoners saw the roommate under the tree, face turned up, watching. After the last burst, {WITCH_NAME} climbed to the upper railing and stayed among them until lockup call.
When the roommate missed it, a prisoner went down with her phone light and found her dead under the tree, eyes open.

In the trial court, the prisoners agreed she had been killed after the show, while {WITCH_NAME} stood with them at the railing. But one prisoner had seen, in that phone light, firework ash lying on the dead girl's open eyes, never blinked away. She had been dead before the first burst, when only {WITCH_NAME} was with her.
fields.epitaph: In the end, she was the one who walked away when the fireworks ended, and left a girl sitting face up to the sky, waiting.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Never Lets the Fireworks End
execution: The execution stand raised an iron firework mortar beneath an iron vault. She sat on the shoulders of a towering iron mother.
The iron mother set her down into the mortar, said "Wait here," and walked away. Chains closed on her inside.
The mortar fired her headfirst up into the iron vault. She dropped back into the mortar and lay still.
The smoke thinned, the court went quiet, and the iron mother did not come back.

magic.name: Fingertip Festival
magic.text: She shoots real fireworks from her fingertips into the air, in any color and shape.
